name: CLM: self-service NDA, legal only for non-standard
description: A CLM self-service NDA. The requester fills the NDA doc-gen form (counterparty, signer, mutual or one-way, template, purpose; the disclosing party shows only for one-way and extra terms only for non-standard) and generates the NDA from its Word template. The doc-gen configuration launches the workflow: the standard template goes straight to the counterparty's signer with no legal touch; a non-standard choice goes to Legal to approve first. The requester is emailed the signed NDA.
prerequisites: The configuration's folder (/Docusign/Legal/NDAs/) exists in CLM; replace the path with yours. Publish the CLM workflow NDA Self Service Routing before the configuration is saved (it launches it).
Legal (legal@example.com in the file) is a CLM user; replace the address and pick the user again after Import.
CLM's eSignature integration is set up for Send for Signature.
